channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: US intel disputes Russian claim of Kyiv drone plot on Putin
item.description: US intelligence agencies had assessed that the strike had not targeted Putin or any of his residences, according to an exclusive by The Wall Street Journal. The post US intel disputes Russian claim of Kyiv drone plot on Putin first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK stages show of force to Argentina in South Atlantic
item.description: A large-scale sovereignty mission across the South Atlantic Islands has seen Royal Navy, British Army and RAF assets operate jointly across South Georgia and Ascension Island. The post UK stages show of force to Argentina in South Atlantic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US conducts series of lethal strikes on narco vessels
item.description: According to US Southern Command (USSOUTHCOM), Joint Task Force Southern Spear conducted three separate strike events between 29 and 31 December 2025. The post US conducts series of lethal strikes on narco vessels first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American artillery ‘opens fire’ in Baltic
item.description: US Army soldiers have conducted live-fire artillery qualifications in Latvia as part of ongoing training activity aimed at maintaining readiness and reinforcing NATO’s eastern flank. The post American artillery ‘opens fire’ in Baltic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy launches one-way attack drone from ship at sea
item.description: Independence-class littoral combat ship USS Santa Barbara launched a Low-cost Unmanned Combat Attack System (LUCAS) while operating in the Gulf. The post U.S. Navy launches one-way attack drone from ship at sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. command aircraft ‘launches’ ballistic missile
item.description: The United States has conducted an operational test launch of an unarmed Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile using an airborne command-and-control system, demonstrating a secondary method of issuing launch commands. The post U.S. command aircraft ‘launches’ ballistic missile first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK develops mobile quantum scanner to study blast effects
item.description: The UK is developing what it describes as the world’s first fully mobile quantum brain scanner designed to measure the effects of blast exposure on military personnel directly at training and operational sites. The post UK develops mobile quantum scanner to study blast effects first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy takes delivery of new destroyer
item.description: The U.S. Navy has formally accepted delivery of the future USS Ted Stevens (DDG-128), a Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided missile destroyer. The post U.S. Navy takes delivery of new destroyer first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American B-52 bombers to get comfier seats
item.description: The U.S. Air Force has completed flight testing of an adaptive seat cushion for the B-52H Stratofortress aimed at reducing aircrew fatigue during long-duration missions. The post American B-52 bombers to get comfier seats first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New nuclear attack submarine to join American fleet
item.description: Once commissioned, Idaho will join the fleet as a multi-mission attack submarine, with roles that include anti-submarine warfare, anti-surface warfare, intelligence collection and support to special operations forces. The post New nuclear attack submarine to join American fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
